facts.text: Peter, you skipped dinner again. Eat first, then tell me where that black eye came from.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. May's real line when she sees Peter's bruises is 'Who keeps doing this to you?'.
facts.fix: Who keeps doing this to you?

fix_note.text: Who keeps doing this to you?

facts.text: Soft vanilla cookies iced in two colours, half.
facts.why: The line is cut off mid sentence on the printed menu. The data reads 'half and half'.
facts.fix: Soft vanilla cookies iced half and half.
